evidence_packet.evidence_text: After fiery, whole-hearted and at times angry campaigns in Gorton and Denton, Makerfield and of course for our local councils, we’re on our fourth election of the year here in GM - and it’s only July But I would argue that voting today is well worth your time. Casting your ballot for a new mayor means you are ushering in the person you think if best placed to handle a multi-billion pound budget, take over the Bee Network, policing oversight, housing and regeneration, adult sk They will also become the public face of England's largest city region outside London. And let’s be honest, our last mayor did pretty well out of that position View 6 Images Seven candidates are in the running to become the new mayor of Greater Manchester (Image: Jason Roberts /Manchester Evening News) We’ve interviewed candidates including Reform UK’s Sian Astley , Green Geraldine Coggins , Labour’s Bev Craig , Conservative Phil Eckersley , Lib Dem Richard Kilpatrick , and Restore Britain’s Marlon West . And while Independent candidate Marcus Farmer very politely declined an i Turnout has struggled ever since the mayoralty was created. It was 29 per cent in 2017. evidence_packet.evidence_text: Polling stations across Greater Manchester have opened in a mayoral election that was triggered when Andy Burnham resigned as the city region's mayor MPs are not permitted to be mayor, meaning Burnham had to stand down after his success in last month's Makerfield parliamentary by-election. His election as an MP paved the way for him becoming prime minister earlier this month Voters are now choosing which candidate they would like to represent them as mayor of Greater Manchester and leader of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority Polling stations opened at 07:00 BST and will close at 22:00. The results are due to be announced on Friday Here is a list - in alphabetical order, by surname - of the seven candidates who are standing in the mayoral election The election will be decided using the supplementary vote (SV) system - meaning voters can choose to select both a first- and second-choice candidate

While Labour has often won elections across the city region, the party's level of support varies For instance, at a time when Labour held 95 of 96 council seats on Manchester City Council, eight of the 10 Greater Manchester boroughs voted leave in the 2016 Brexit referendum.
